topics.title: Nerandomilast – SSc Ph3 Development Plan (China Integration)

background.text: CN approval base case: 2031 (to be updated). Based on SSc-ILD subgroup analysis from FIBRONEER-ILD, SSc Ph3 trial is under development without waiting for SSc-ILD Ph2b results. HAI before TDO finalization planned in Q3 2025; global CTA submission planned for Q1 2026.
background.quote:
Based on the SSc-ILD subgroup analysis from FIBRONEER-ILD, the SSc phase 3 trial is under development without waiting for the SSc-ILD phase 2b results.
HAI before TDO finalization was planned in Q3 2025 and global CTA submission is planned for Q1 2026.

background.text: On the 2025 INFL TA Key Milestone Overview slide, Nerandomilast FIBRONEER-SARD Ph3b 1st SIV is listed as on-hold (TBU), indicating a hold risk for the SARD/SSc development track.

todo.text: Preparation for HAI (planned Q3 2025); owner and completed status not stated in source.
